checkedAlternates.risk: Hapkido and Aikido share the same Chinese characters.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Hapkido was codified in Korea (group-2), whereas Aikido was founded by Morihei Ueshiba in Japan (group-4).

checkedAlternates.risk: Karate has historical roots from Ryukyu/China.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Modern Karate was systematized in Okinawa and mainland Japan (group-4), not mainland China (group-3).
